title: Behind the Mask: Demographic bias in name detection for PII masking

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in customer service text templates using names statistically associated with specific racial and ethnic groups, measuring and comparing the False Negative Rate (FNR) of off-the-shelf PII masking systems.

Counterfactual name substitution in text templates using names strongly associated with specific genders, comparing the False Negative Rate (FNR) of PII redaction models across male-associated, female-associated, and unassociated names.

Evaluating the False Negative Rates (FNR) of PII masking models using names categorized by both race/ethnicity and gender simultaneously (e.g., Black female-associated names) to uncover compounded demographic disparities.
